summary: E: fresh (BEST 1.6340 / blob 2eb03f76 unchanged since mint; parent reviewed 'proceed'). The -std=c++20 fix is sufficient. The extra_cflags addition is redundant but harmless. A scan of the never-compiled fvg CUDA text found no obvious compile error. Widen the build-error tail so a second failure can be read.
justification: Fix sufficiency: the #error came from the nvcc compile of cuda.cu (gcc-style caret output from the host pass). load_inline appends extra_cuda_cflags after torch's own default -std=c++20, so the explicit -std=c++17 in _FVG_FLAGS won. The '[2/3] ccache c++ ... main.o' line after the error is only ninja's progress line; no failure output follows it. Master's sk, skF and slide modules pass no -std and no extra_cflags and build on the judge, so torch's default host flags are already C++20. Setting -std=c++20 matches c320 (L6812) and sw (L8824), and nvcc on the judge accepts it because sw built in the same log. extra_cflags=['-O3','-std=c++20'] is a no-op safety. Dropping -std from _FVG_FLAGS would work equally well. Scan of _FVG_CUDA (branch L9437-9988): the wgmma operand counts are consistent (qk %0-31 d, %32-35 a, %36 desc, %37 acc; pv likewise with tnspB). The scale/transpose immediates match the e4m3 (no transpose) and f16 register-A forms. The cudaLaunchKernelEx template call matches the KFn signature arg for arg. The cond ? attr : nullptr array decay is legal. Includes cover C10_CUDA_CHECK, at::kInt and uintptr_t. The pin() asm '::' clobber form is the CUTLASS idiom. Device lambdas need no --extended-lambda. Dynamic smem is about 87 KB x MINB 2, under the 227 KB limit. Weakest link: this exact stripped text has never been compiled anywhere (the parent md says the node has no nvcc), so a second build or ptxas error is possible. A minor candidate is wg_pv's 'setp.ne.b32 p, 1, 0' with an immediate first operand. ptxas normally accepts it, but copying wg_qk's register form (or folding the constant) removes the doubt at no cost.
interference: No companions are needed. This is a one-flag restack of a reviewed hypothesis, and the parent review's race, gates and confounder reasoning carry over unchanged.
freshness: E: BEST.json 1.6340 (job 4e386647edd845f7) and master blob 2eb03f76 are both unchanged since mint 2026-10-29T222928Z. This moved 0.00% against a 1.24% margin, so the hypothesis is fresh. The parent's check 06c05172 failed only at build, so it carries no performance evidence against the claim.
open_questions: Raise the build error capture from str(e)[-600:] to about 3000 chars, as [sw] does (L8840). The parent's 600-char tail cut off the root compiler line. A second failure in this never-compiled text should be diagnosable from one judge log.

TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST is not pinned for fvg. torch adds its default sm_90 gencode next to the explicit compute_90a, which compiles the #else stub (error bit 4). Master's sk/skF builders also set and restore os.environ['TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST'] while the fvg thread runs, so the arch list depends on timing. The runtime should load the sm_90a cubin on H100/H200. If the stub ran, the import-time counter/error-word check (L10205) keeps master, so this is safe but could waste the check. Optional: drop the duplicate gencode, or note in the [fvg] print which cubin ran (fvg_attr numRegs > ~40 implies the real kernel).
